title: Throughput Gap Analysis — Board I
type: Read-Only Gap Analysis — No Content Modifications
authority: S350 Throughput Metrics (Board B); S350 Framework v2 Scorecard (Board K); S204 Throughput Pilot (Board I); S205 Throughput Revalidation (Board I)
purpose: Compare S350 targets against current infrastructure state. Do not claim observed throughput gains.

s350_throughput_targets_vs_current_infra.note: S350 defines throughput targets at three phases (P1/P2/P3). Current state is P0 (pre-Hybrid) — Framework v2 infrastructure is built but not yet processing certification waves. All throughput measurements reflect v1 operations.

TH-001_items_reviewed_per_hour.gap: P0→P1 transition requires at least one v2-assisted certification wave to begin measuring. S322 scripts are advisory but not yet used in production certification sessions.
TH-001_items_reviewed_per_hour.what_changes_at_p1: Pre-flight gates run before board reviews. Items arrive READY (no BLOCKED/REMEDIATE items in review queue). Single-pass review instead of multi-round firefighting.

TH-002_items_certified_per_session.gap: Batch velocity improvements from pre-flight gating and delta review are architectural — they activate when boards consume the scan artifact and when the delta ledger has comparison data.
TH-002_items_certified_per_session.what_changes_at_p1: Pre-flight reduces items entering boards by 242 (BLOCKED) + 77 (REMEDIATE). Delta review (once comparison data exists) skips unchanged items. Combined: fewer unique items per wave × faster per-item review = higher certified-per-session.

TH-003_cycle_time.gap: Cycle time reduction comes from single-pass review (pre-flight catches issues before boards) and delta review (unchanged items skip). Both depend on infrastructure that is operational (S322) but not yet consumed by active certification boards.

TH-009_throughput_multiplier.infrastructure_ready_for_p1: PARTIAL — pre-flight gating is ready (S322 demonstrates 0.7s full-pool scan). Delta review requires comparison data (first comparison at S206/S830). Board consolidation (8→5) is specified but not yet adopted by certification sessions.
TH-009_throughput_multiplier.gap: The 1.5-2.0× P1 target requires: (a) pre-flight operational with board visibility enforcement, (b) at least one session operating with 5-board model. Neither condition is met at S351. Both are achievable with current infrastructure.

TH-010_cost_per_item.gap: 50% waste ratio in v1 (phantom investigations, duplicate reviews, template remediation). Waste reduction depends on: identity validation eliminating false positives, pre-flight gating eliminating re-reviews, delta review eliminating unchanged-item re-audits.

operational_improvements.BF-007_identity_ambiguity: PARTIAL — compound-key identity operational at 99.96% (Gate -1). 1 item blocked (P1-E-R33). 8 forbidden methodologies active (FM-001 through FM-008). No new S320-class wrong-variant failures.
operational_improvements.BF-009_defect_timing: PARTIAL — pre-flight pipeline is operational (S322: 0.7s, 2,540 items). Scans execute but are advisory, not blocking. 0% pre-flight detection in v1 baseline → infrastructure exists for 78% target.

unchanged_metrics.BF-004_readiness_failure: 89.5% (v1 baseline — v2 infrastructure not yet preventing leakage)
unchanged_metrics.BF-006_re_review_rate: 80% (v1 active — delta review not yet operational)

bf_metrics_at_p0.analysis: 1 of 10 BF metrics shows partial improvement (BF-007). BF-009 infrastructure is operational but not yet producing results. 8 of 10 BF metrics are unchanged from v1 baseline — Framework v2 is not yet processing certification waves. This is the expected state at P0.

pre_flight_gating.status: OPERATIONAL — S322 demo: Gates -1 through 4, 0.7s, 2,540 items
pre_flight_gating.gap_to_p1: Board visibility enforcement not active. Scan is advisory, not blocking. Items still enter Certification Board regardless of readiness state.
pre_flight_gating.resolution: Activate governance Rules 6-7 (READY-gate mandatory, Identity-validation mandatory). S205 activated them at specification level. Operationally enforced at S206+.

delta_review.status: NOT_OPERATIONAL — infrastructure built (hash_engine.js, delta_ledger_builder.js). Requires comparison data.
delta_review.gap_to_p1: First comparison data available at S206 (second scan artifact). Until then, all items require full review.
delta_review.resolution: Execute S206 T0 scan → produce second artifact → delta_ledger_builder.js computes first comparison → items with UNCHANGED classification become eligible for CertifiedDelta inheritance.

board_consolidation.status: SPECIFIED — 5-board model defined in S202. v1 boards still operate.
board_consolidation.gap_to_p1: v1 boards (8) have not migrated to v2 board model. S350 Board Efficiency Model documents the savings (47% board reduction, 57% scope overlap elimination).
board_consolidation.resolution: S208+ (Shadow Mode) — boards migrate from 8 to 5 as v2 becomes authoritative.

compound_key_identity.status: PARTIALLY_OPERATIONAL — Steps 1-3 validated (S204). Steps 4-5 deferred to S206.
compound_key_identity.gap_to_p1: TemplateFamily classification and compound key resolution not yet computed for all 2,540 items. Until complete, S320-class prevention is governance-layer only (Rules 9-10).

throughput_claim_restraint.s204_observed: 85-93% marginal savings projected (S204 Board I). Break-even at 72-150 items (mid-Phase 1). These are architectural projections, not operational measurements.
throughput_claim_restraint.s205_revalidated: S202 projections confirmed as conservative. Verified against engineering plan. Still projections — no v2 certification wave has executed.
throughput_claim_restraint.s351_stance: S351 does not claim any observed throughput gains. All throughput targets remain aspirational until the first v2-assisted certification wave completes. The infrastructure required to achieve each target exists (S322) but has not been applied to production certification.
throughput_claim_restraint.next_measurement: S830 (Phase 2 Authorization Gate). All 10 BF metrics must be ≥20% improved from v1 baseline. First operational throughput data from P1 certification waves.
